identifiedDependencies.reason: Core library for client-side video processing using WebAssembly.
Helper library for @ffmpeg/ffmpeg, used for loading core files.

assetInstructions:
This tool uses FFmpeg.wasm and requires its core files to be available locally.

1.  Download the FFmpeg.wasm core files (v0.12.6 or compatible). You can typically find these in the `@ffmpeg/core` package on npm.
2.  From the downloaded package, locate the `dist/` directory.
3.  Copy the following files from the `dist/` directory into the `public/data/clip-video/ffmpeg/` directory of this project:
    *   `ffmpeg-core.js`
    *   `ffmpeg-core.wasm`
